label: Schrödinger evolution
intuition: The Hamiltonian sets how the state changes. Energy differences make relative phases turn.

label: A cavity feels its bath
intuition: The field rotates, leaks, and is shaken by the input. One Markovian port, in a rotating frame.

label: Pauli: exchanging levels
intuition: Acting with sigma-x swaps the two basis states. A spin rotation is generated by it.

label: A state becomes a picture
intuition: For a qubit, the Bloch vector tells you its direction and purity. Mixed states sit inside the sphere.
source: Open Quantum System/The Markovian Master Equation

label: What leaves the cavity
intuition: The outgoing field adds the incoming wave to the field radiated by the cavity. Their amplitudes can interfere.

label: Pauli: relative phase
intuition: One basis component changes sign; the other stays. Relative phase changes without swapping populations.

label: The same dynamics, another picture
intuition: In the Heisenberg picture the observable moves. If it commutes with H, it is conserved when it has no explicit time dependence.

label: Coherent light
intuition: A coherent state has a definite complex field amplitude, while its photon count still fluctuates.

label: Pauli: order matters
intuition: Changing the order of two spin operations changes the result. The leftover points along the third axis.

label: Two quadratures, one field
intuition: The two quadratures are the real and imaginary parts of the field. Measuring one sharply costs uncertainty in the other.

label: Closed-system density dynamics
intuition: Unitary evolution changes the orientation of the state, preserving its eigenvalues and purity.

label: Quantum fluctuations remain
intuition: A coherent state reaches the minimum uncertainty, but even the vacuum has quadrature fluctuations. Here a=q+ip.

label: Lowering an atom
intuition: It takes an excited atom to its ground state. Acting on the ground state gives zero.

label: Damping is not only friction
intuition: In the Markov limit the input has a delta-time commutator. The bath supplies quantum noise as well as damping.

label: Counting pairs of photons
intuition: Pairs arrive less often than a Poisson stream when g² is below one: antibunching. The mean count must be nonzero.

label: Resonant excitation exchange
intuition: For an initially excited atom and n photons on resonance, excitation swings between atom and field. The vacuum also couples.

label: Dissipation changes the state
intuition: At zero temperature, an emission channel drains excitation. The Hamiltonian and the bath shape the state together.

label: What a jump channel does
intuition: The jump term transfers probability. The anticommutator balances it, so the total probability stays one.

label: A mixture is still one state
intuition: Different mixtures can represent the same density matrix. Measurements see rho, not a unique story of its preparation.

label: Coherent photon counting
intuition: For coherent light, N is the mean photon number. The variance also equals N: counting noise remains.

label: Energy turns into phase
intuition: For a time-independent Hamiltonian, each energy component acquires its own phase. Interference reveals their differences.

label: Spin has a scale
intuition: A Pauli operator is dimensionless. Multiplying by hbar/2 gives the angular momentum of a spin-half particle.
